value.rationale: The exact sqrt(epsilon) selection and divergent order of equilibrium/penalty limits quantify a genuine interpretation risk in fractional liquid-democracy regularization: nearly cyclic individual behavior can still produce almost fully counted voting weights. The closed-form phase boundary and nonnegative payoff construction are motivated by the source paper’s mechanism and its zero-penalty limit, not arbitrary finite enumeration.
